settings.about.autoCheckName: Check for updates when the launcher starts
settings.about.statusNotDue: The last check was less than 24 hours ago
settings.about.title: About & updates
settings.appData.dialogClearContent:
Only the folder written by older versions on C: is deleted:
{0}

The data folder next to the program is untouched, and the official Paradox launcher data is never modified.

Delete it?
settings.appData.dialogClearFailedTitle: Could not delete the old C: data
settings.appData.hint: Settings, logs and every cache live in the data subfolder next to the program, so the whole folder can be moved with it.
settings.appData.statusMissing: The old C: data folder does not exist: {0}
settings.cache.dialogClearAllContent: This deletes the local caches for theme assets, official news, mod thumbnails and DLC descriptions; they are fetched again when needed.\n\nClear them?
settings.cache.hint: Each of the four caches has its own subfolder; clearing only removes caches, never settings.json, logs or the playset database.
settings.cache.row.dlcDescriptions.desc: Description text from the Steam store; expires after the configured days
settings.cache.row.dlcDescriptions.title: DLC descriptions
settings.cache.row.images.desc: Intermediate DDS-to-PNG results; rebuilt the next time thumbnails are shown
settings.cache.row.images.title: Image conversion cache
settings.cache.row.modThumbnails.desc: Pruned by the retention days; downloaded again the next time the mod library opens
settings.cache.row.modThumbnails.title: Mod thumbnails
settings.cache.row.news.desc: News cards and images; expire after 6 hours
settings.cache.row.news.title: Official news
settings.cache.row.theme.desc: Backgrounds and wordmarks downloaded online; expire after 5 days and are fetched again on the next check
settings.cache.row.theme.title: Theme assets
settings.cache.row.translations.desc: Translated titles, descriptions and comments; cleared entries are requested from the translation service again the next time they are shown
settings.cache.row.translations.title: Translations
settings.cacheRowWorkshopDesc: Names, authors, ratings, covers and details of workshop mods; reused whenever the same id appears again.
settings.danger.dialogContent:
This recalculates the DLC signature from the files on disk and overwrites dlc_signature in the game folder.

The CK3 signature written by the official launcher cannot be reproduced byte for byte, so the game may flag the DLC set as modified.

Continue?
settings.danger.hint: The CK3 signature cannot be reproduced byte for byte, so regenerating it may flag the DLC set as modified. Nothing is written by default.
settings.danger.statusAllowed: dlc_signature writes allowed: only when you press Regenerate
settings.danger.statusForbiddenFirst: dlc_signature writes are blocked: enable the switch above first
settings.data.dlcDays1.desc: Refresh daily: always current, most network traffic
settings.data.dlcDays14.desc: Refresh every two weeks, for stable networks
settings.data.dlcDays30.desc: Refresh once a month, lowest traffic
settings.data.dlcHint: CK3 / Stellaris .dlc files carry no description; when enabled the launcher queries the Steam store by appid and caches the text. Victoria 3 uses the description from its .dlc.json.
settings.data.fileMissing: File missing (created on the first game launch)
settings.data.newsHint: News cards come from the official launcher content cards endpoint and are cached for 6 hours.
settings.data.statusDlcDays: DLC descriptions now kept for {0} days
settings.data.statusDlcOff: DLC descriptions off: local text and cache only
settings.data.statusNewsOff: Official news off: local cache only
settings.interface.alwaysOnTop.desc: When pinned the launcher stays above other windows; click the pin in the title bar or press Ctrl+Shift+T to unpin.
settings.interface.background.center.des: Center at the original pixel size and crop what overflows
settings.interface.background.cover.desc: Scale to fill the window and crop the sides; same as the original launcher
settings.interface.background.fill.desc: Stretch to fill the window: nothing is cropped, but the image distorts
settings.interface.background.fill.title: Fill (stretch)
settings.interface.background.fullBlur.d: Show the whole image and pad the edges with a blurred copy
Show the whole image with the window background around it
settings.interface.hint: Changes are saved immediately: the background layout applies at once, the playset layout and mod image size on the next visit.
settings.interface.language.enUS.desc: Interface and DLC descriptions in English (descriptions come from the Steam store).
settings.interface.language.enUS.title: English
settings.interface.language.system.desc: Follow the Windows display language: Chinese uses Simplified Chinese, anything else uses English.
settings.interface.language.system.title: Follow system
settings.interface.language.zhCN.desc: Interface and DLC descriptions in Simplified Chinese.
settings.interface.language.zhCN.title: 简体中文
settings.interface.playset.official.desc: The playset switcher lives in the toolbar; every change is saved and written to the game load file
settings.interface.playset.placeholder.d: Reserved layout: the playset page shows nothing
settings.interface.size.large.title: Large
settings.interface.size.medium.desc: 48 px: the default used by both the mod library and playsets
settings.interface.size.medium.title: Medium
settings.interface.size.small.desc: 32 px: more mods per screen, smaller thumbnails
settings.interface.size.small.title: Small
settings.interface.statusAlwaysOnTop: Window pinned: the launcher stays above other windows (Ctrl+Shift+T to unpin)
settings.interface.statusAlwaysOnTopOff: Unpinned: clicking other programs switches normally
settings.interface.statusBackground: Background layout set to "{0}" and applied immediately
settings.interface.statusLanguage: Language switched to "{0}"; DLC descriptions use it from the next load
settings.interface.statusPlaySet: Playset page layout set to "{0}"; it applies when you return to the page
settings.interface.statusThumbnailSize: Mod image size set to "{0}" ({1} px); it applies when you return to the mod library or playset
settings.modThumbnails.days30.desc: Default: keep a month of thumbnails, fine for a few hundred subscribed mods
settings.modThumbnails.days365.desc: Practically permanent; only removed by manual cleanup
settings.modThumbnails.days7.desc: Smallest footprint: images unused for a week are removed and downloaded again later
settings.modThumbnails.days90.desc: Keep three months; big libraries can reach hundreds of MB
settings.modThumbnails.hint: Online lookup only happens when no local thumbnail can be parsed; afterwards the local cache is used.
settings.modThumbnails.statusOnlineOff: Mod thumbnail download off: local images and existing cache only
settings.modThumbnails.statusOnlineOn: Mod thumbnail download on (cached in the data folder)
settings.modThumbnails.statusRetention: Mod thumbnail retention set to {0} days; expired images are pruned the next time the library loads
settings.patch.applyDialogContent:
The current steam_api will be backed up next to itself as *_o.dll, replaced by the loader, and cream_api.ini will be generated.

Close the game first. Afterwards, launch it from this launcher.

Apply the patch?
settings.patch.hint: Applies the DLC unlock patch to the selected game: replaces steam_api with the loader and writes cream_api.ini. Only the current game is touched, and it can be removed at any time to restore the original Steam files. Game content files are never modified, and nothing is downloaded.
settings.patch.removeDialogContent:
The backed-up Steam steam_api will be moved back into place and the cream_api.ini generated by this launcher will be deleted.

The game must be closed. Remove the patch?
settings.patch.state.patchedOther: Patched by another tool (not this launcher)
settings.patch.state.steamOverwrote: Patch overwritten by a Steam update (backup still present)
settings.patch.state.unsupported: Cannot patch (missing Steam appId or patch assets)
settings.patch.title: Patch
settings.proxy.detectedHint: A proxy is configured on this machine but the launcher is connecting directly; direct connections can hang when DNS is hijacked. Use it to switch over.
settings.proxy.hint: Applies immediately and rebuilds the whole network stack (an in-flight download may fail once); PAC scripts are never executed.
settings.proxy.mode.direct.desc: No proxy at all; pick this when Paradox services are reachable directly.
settings.proxy.mode.direct.title: Direct
settings.proxy.mode.manual.desc: Only use the address below, for example the HTTP port of Clash / v2rayN: 127.0.0.1:7890.
settings.proxy.mode.manual.title: Manual
settings.proxy.mode.system.desc: Use the proxy configured in Windows Settings; when there is none, fall back to the http_proxy / https_proxy environment variables.
settings.proxy.mode.system.title: Follow system
settings.proxy.status.notInitialized: Startup has not finished initializing; the proxy setting will take effect on next launch
settings.proxy.status.rebuildFailed: Could not rebuild the network stack, keeping the previous proxy: {0}
settings.section.name: Settings sections
settings.status.name: Status
settings.status.selectGameFirst: Pick a game in the library first
settings.steamStateHint: Read real workshop item state (subscribed / installed / update available / downloading / disabled locally in Steam) and show it in the mod library and detail page. Read-only; each query starts a short-lived child process, during which Steam briefly lists this app as "in game".
settings.steamSubscribeHint: When on, the Subscribe button on a Workshop detail page subscribes or unsubscribes through the Steam client. When off, it only opens the item in the Steam client. Requires steam_api64.dll next to the launcher or in the game folder.
settings.theme.hint: Backgrounds and wordmarks come from the metadata service and are cached for 5 days; colors and fonts always come from theme-settings.json in the install folder.
settings.theme.statusDone: Theme check finished: source={0}, next check {1}
settings.theme.statusOff: Theme check off: only the game folder and the built-in placeholder are used
settings.title: Settings
settings.translate.engine.auto.desc: Prefer the OpenAI-compatible API configured below, then Microsoft Translator and Google Cloud Translation, and finally fall back to the built-in free service.
settings.translate.engine.auto.title: Automatic (recommended)
settings.translate.engine.bergamot.desc: The neural machine translation model behind Firefox web translation: 48-70 MB with millisecond responses. It does not know game proper nouns, so the glossary below is what fixes them.
settings.translate.engine.bergamot.title: Bergamot only (offline, fastest and smallest)
settings.translate.engine.builtin.desc: Uses the public Google Translate web endpoint; no key is required. It is an unofficial public endpoint and may change at any time, so availability is not guaranteed.
settings.translate.engine.builtin.title: Google free translation (no key)
settings.translate.engine.custom.desc: Only call the API configured below; a missing key or a failed call is a failure, with no fallback.
settings.translate.engine.custom.title: Configured API only
settings.translate.engine.googleCloud.de: Calls the official Google Cloud Translation API; requires an API key. The free tier allows 500 thousand characters per month.
settings.translate.engine.indexTranslate: A small translation model that runs fully offline with the best quality and forced terminology alignment. The model is about 1.3 GB and takes roughly one second per sentence on CPU; there is no fallback to other engines.
settings.translate.engine.local.desc: Prefer the on-device offline models (download them below first); when no model is installed or translation fails, fall back to the configured API, Microsoft Translator, Google Cloud Translation, MyMemory and the built-in free service.
settings.translate.engine.local.title: Local offline translation
settings.translate.engine.microsoft.desc: Calls Microsoft Azure Translator; requires a subscription key and region. The free tier allows 2 million characters per month.
settings.translate.engine.mymemory.desc: Calls the public MyMemory API and needs no API key. One request is limited to 500 characters, so long text is split automatically. Usually still reachable on networks where the Google endpoint fails.
settings.translate.engine.mymemory.title: MyMemory translation (no key)
settings.translate.glossaryHint: The glossary feeds both local engines: Index-Translate uses it to force proper nouns into place, Bergamot uses it as a direct replacement table. It only affects the local engines.
settings.translate.googleCloud.hint: Google Cloud Translation needs the Cloud Translation API enabled and an API key: Enable APIs -> search Cloud Translation API -> Enable -> Credentials -> Create credentials -> API key. The first 500,000 characters each month are free; only the key goes here, no project name.
settings.translate.googleCloud.portal: Open Google Cloud console to create an API key
settings.translate.hint: Translations are shown next to the original. The API URL and key are stored in the local settings.json only and are never written to the log; the built-in free service is a third-party public endpoint whose availability is not guaranteed.
settings.translate.keepLoadedDesc: When on, the local model stays loaded so translations start instantly. When off, it is unloaded after 5 idle minutes to free about 1.3 GB, and the next translation reloads it (a few seconds slower).
settings.translate.language.enUS.desc: Always translate into English, whatever the interface language is.
settings.translate.language.enUS.title: English
settings.translate.language.follow.desc: Chinese interface means Chinese output, English interface means English output.
settings.translate.language.follow.title: Follow the interface language
settings.translate.language.zhCN.desc: Always translate into Simplified Chinese, whatever the interface language is.
settings.translate.language.zhCN.title: 简体中文
settings.translate.localModelStatusRemov: Could not delete the local model: {0}
settings.translate.localModelsHint: Once a model is downloaded the translation runs fully offline, using no network and no keys. The first Index-Translate-2B download is about 1.3 GB, so make sure there is enough free disk space.
settings.translate.microsoft.hint: Microsoft Translator needs a Translator resource in your Azure subscription: Create a resource -> search Translator -> pick the F0 tier (2 million characters per month free) -> after it is created copy KEY 1 from Keys and Endpoint, and set the region to the resource location (for example eastasia or global).
settings.translate.microsoft.portal: Open the Azure portal to create a Translator resource
settings.translate.microsoftRegionName: Region of the Microsoft Translator resource
settings.translate.statusDisabled: Translation disabled: no translation requests are sent
settings.translate.statusEnabled: Translation enabled: workshop lists, details and comments show a translation next to the original
settings.translate.statusKeepLoadedOff: Model will be unloaded after 5 idle minutes
settings.translate.statusKeepLoadedOn: Model will stay loaded in memory
settings.translate.testName: Test whether each translation engine works
update.available.body: You are on {0}; version {1} is available. The installer will be downloaded, verified, and launched.
update.elevationCanceled: Administrator approval was canceled; the update did not start.
update.installerStarted: The installer has started. The launcher will now exit.
update.perMachineHint: This installation is shared by all users; updating requires administrator approval (UAC).
update.ready: The update is ready. The launcher will exit and install it.
